notes: בְּעֵינֶיךָ recast as *Thinkest thou*: preposition and noun fuse on *Thinkest* (rules 30/40), suffix keeps *thou*; the interrogative הַ takes the *that* subordinating the recast question, with הַ unrepresented / *that* added as the named competing reading.
Second question: fronted *are* goes to הֲ (rule 17), בָּאוּ keeps *come*; בַּעֲבוּר unrendered, the three *to*s belong to the infinitives' לְ.
